meta.source: 80fen repo ui/ (leo-theme.css, LEARNING-DESIGN.md, learn/DESIGN.md) + promo film

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: 题内页面底色。正文用 ink / ink-soft。Lesson screens ground.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: 首页与结尾卡底色；深色底上的文字色（on felt 6.7:1，on felt-deep 10:1，on felt-table 4.6:1）。Home ground; text on dark greens.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 进度条轨道、分隔线；纯装饰（on paper 1.3:1）。Tracks and dividers only.

tokens.name: card-face
tokens.usage: 牌面、讲解气泡、选项底色。Card faces, bubbles, options.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: 主文字与所有粗描边，与六六轮廓同色。on paper 16:1，on honey 9.6:1。Text and all outlines.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: 次要文字。on paper 7.6:1，on cream 7:1。Secondary text.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: 禁用、占位、✕ 图标。on paper 4.0:1，只用于 ≥18px。Disabled, close icon.

tokens.name: sticker-shadow
tokens.usage: 贴纸实心投影颜色。Solid sticker shadow colour.

tokens.name: felt
tokens.usage: 品牌深绿：单元标签、答对横幅、模式栏；cream 文字 6.7:1。Brand green.

tokens.name: felt-table
tokens.usage: 牌桌台面；cream 文字 4.6:1，不放 honey 小字。Table surface.

tokens.name: felt-deep
tokens.usage: 深色场景底；honey 文字 6.4:1。Dark scenes.

tokens.name: honey
tokens.usage: 强调＝你 / 当前 / 下一步：主按钮、当前课程牌、你的座位、分数。ink 文字 9.6:1；在 paper 上必须带 ink 描边。Accent = you / now / next.

tokens.name: honey-deep
tokens.usage: honey 底上的装饰花色与纹理，不用于文字。Decoration on honey.

tokens.name: brick
tokens.usage: 红桃/方块花色、牌背、答错、对手；牌面上 4.7:1。Red suits, card back, wrong, opponents.

tokens.name: brick-deep
tokens.usage: 砖红作底承载文字时用它（cream 5.6:1）。Brick when it carries text.

tokens.name: suit-spade
tokens.usage: ♠ 黑桃：墨色（牌面上 17:1）。Spades: ink.

tokens.name: suit-heart
tokens.usage: ♥ 红桃：砖红（4.7:1）。Hearts: brick red.

tokens.name: suit-diamond
tokens.usage: ♦ 方块：琥珀橙，与红桃靠色相和形状区分（4.7:1）。Diamonds: amber, apart from hearts.

tokens.name: suit-club
tokens.usage: ♣ 梅花：深绿，与黑桃区分（6.4:1）。Clubs: deep green, apart from spades.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: 选择态与焦点环；on paper 5.3:1。Selection and focus.

tokens.name: teal-tint
tokens.usage: 选中选项底色（teal 文字 4.8:1）。Selected option fill.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: 答对选项底色（felt 文字 6.5:1）。Correct option fill.

tokens.name: err-tint
tokens.usage: 答错选项底色（brick-deep 文字 5.3:1）。Wrong option fill.

tokens.name: lock-face
tokens.usage: 未解锁课程牌牌背。Locked lesson card.

tokens.name: lock-ink
tokens.usage: 未解锁课程牌上的字与锁（on lock-face 5.6:1）。Text on locked cards.

families.heading: "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif
families.sans: "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: 答对横幅、结尾卡主标题；一屏最多一处。

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 出的是同一门，最大的那张收走这一墩。

styles.name: body-compact
styles.sample: 分是算一队的，不算个人的。

styles.name: label
styles.sample: 本关：所有人手里只有红桃
styles.usage: 辅助标签、课程牌名；最小字号。

styles.name: hero-en
styles.usage: Feedback headline, end card. One per screen.

styles.name: body-en
styles.sample: Same suit, highest card wins the trick.

styles.name: num-xl
styles.usage: 分数、80 大字。Scores, the big 80.

styles.name: num-lg
styles.usage: 课程编号、统计。Lesson numbers, stats.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: 图标与文字、牌的露边。Icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: 标签竖向内边距。Tag padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: 选中牌上移、卡片内边距。Selected lift, card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: 页面最小左右边距。Page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: 讲解框内边距。Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: 区块间距。Section gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: 大区块间距。Large gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: 页面顶部留白。Top margin.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: 小块。Small pieces.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: 选项、气泡。Options, bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: 牌桌、横幅。Table, banners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: 按钮、标签、进度条。Buttons, tags, bars.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: 扑克牌与课程牌，随 font-size 缩放。Cards; scales with font-size.

shadow.note: 贴纸感：实心、零模糊、只向下。Sticker look: solid, no blur, downward only.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: 按钮、标签、座位、牌桌。Buttons, tags, seats, table.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: 扑克牌、课程牌。Cards.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: 按下态，配合 translateY(3px)。Pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-dark
tokens.usage: 深绿底上的物件。On dark greens.

stroke.note: 粗描边是签名，与六六的轮廓同一支笔。

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: 小于 40px 的牌与标签。Small cards, tags.

tokens.name: stroke-ui
tokens.usage: 按钮、选项、气泡、座位。Controls.

tokens.name: stroke-bold
tokens.usage: 牌桌、横幅、大牌。Table, banners, large cards.

tokens.name: size-tap
tokens.usage: 最小点击高度。Minimum tap target.

tokens.name: size-coach
tokens.usage: 六六教练头像。Coach avatar.

tokens.name: size-card-hand
tokens.usage: 手牌宽（高 66）。Hand card width.

tokens.name: size-lesson-card
tokens.usage: 课程牌宽（高 148）。Lesson card width.

tokens.name: fan-tilt
tokens.usage: 扇形最外侧牌的旋转角。Outermost card tilt in a fan.

tokens.name: fan-drop
tokens.usage: 扇形最外侧牌比中间低多少。How much the outer cards sit lower.

tokens.name: dur-tap
tokens.usage: 按下/松开。Press.

tokens.name: dur-blink
tokens.usage: 六六眨眼闭眼帧时长。Blink closed frame.

tokens.name: dur-stamp
tokens.usage: 大字盖章。Stamp-in.

tokens.name: dur-slide
tokens.usage: 题目切换、牌飞入。Slides, card flight.

tokens.name: dur-pop
tokens.usage: 弹出（配 ease-back）。Pop-in.

tokens.name: dur-beat
tokens.usage: 随节拍轻弹。Beat bounce.

tokens.name: dur-breathe
tokens.usage: 六六呼吸起伏周期。Idle breathing cycle.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: 入场、移动。Enter, move.

tokens.name: ease-back
tokens.usage: 弹出过冲。Pop with overshoot.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: 转场、收牌。Transitions.
